artifact.digest_scope: Instructions, reference, three case suites and license. Historical review records are retained separately.

decision_question: Can the existing AskJamie skill publish precise application-attempt, current-field and submitted-artifact reconciliation as portable source?
acceptance_criteria: Unique attempt match before each attempt-specific claim or write.
Preserve history, uncertain dates, exact submitted evidence and per-source coverage.
Require guarded overwrites and idempotent or serialized repeatable writes.
Use synthetic public cases and bound evidence claims to source inspection.
source_basis: Private workflow patterns were abstracted into synthetic fixtures. No private source data was included.
Equilibrium Review 1.0.1 and Skill Foundry 3.1.1 governed the review.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Evidence, outcome, and safety used separate read-only contexts with a shared model family and overlapping source set.
The outcome reviewer performed the conditional falsification retest. The integration author adjudicated and retargeted the change over the concurrent releases.
No live execution or blinded grading.

initial_reviews.finding: Make date semantics, candidate-reported milestones, and attempt-linked attachment provenance explicit. Preserve upstream case IDs and correct ambiguous expectations.
Keep saved-opportunity triage separate. Reconciliation owns exact-attempt decisions, evidence and verified deltas. Preserve the merged portfolio coverage and conflict rules.
Bind every claim and correction to one attempt. Hold conflicting shared stages, require guards, and separate application actions from status maintenance.

concordance: Material fixture, write-guard, and attempt-scope findings were corrected in the final source.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: An editable shared badge can collapse two distinct attempts.
falsification_hypotheses.test: External inactivation and active internal receipt share one editable posting badge.
falsification_hypotheses.result: Hold the shared stage when its schema cannot represent the distinction.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Successful readback can mask an intervening edit.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Pre-read Draft, second writer sets Interview, first proposes Submitted without a guard.
falsification_hypotheses.result: Stage the proposed change. Retain the existing same-field-race case.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Two writers may append the same event after each sees an empty pre-read.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Provide plain append only, concurrent writers and no destination deduplication.
falsification_hypotheses.result: Hold the append. The added duplicate-append case tests the missing guard.

decisive_evidence: The final unique-attempt and same-claim rules apply across dispositions, receipts, and artifact references.
The field reference separates current closure and reminders from historical evidence.
The new attempt detail suite covers stale fields, packet identity, shared stage, agency handoff and duplicate append.
unresolved_items: No live host or connector mutation behavior was evaluated.

applicability: Source distribution in the existing AskJamie capability.
expiry: Re-review if hashed files, write policy, or claimed host support change.

validations.check: Portable format, relative references, license, frozen SHA-256 and privacy scan

limitations: Live benchmark, measured uplift, trigger evaluation, platform installation, and unseen holdout were not run.
Write safety depends on the destination actually enforcing its declared guard. Cross-surface atomicity is unverified.
Prior release reviews remain historical for this version.
